A '''medical robe''' was a loose garment. The robe was standard issue aboard all [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigates]] and science [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], and worn by patients and test subjects alike. [[Galen Marek]] wore one on the ''[[Empirical]]''.
